smoothing: Same causal trailing mean over 200 evaluation positions for every method; smoothing applies to displayed aggregate curves only; reported MIC values and per-task plots remain exact.
score_caveat: All methods capped at 4,000 acquisition proposals or 4,000 fresh evaluations, whichever first. Frozen history uses the last fully measured batch within both caps; crossing batches excluded, so two tasks stop at 3,990 fresh. Stops after 80 rounds can leave fewer than 4,000 fresh. No fabricated extra observations.
runtime_caveat: All 4,000-fresh runtimes are linear estimates using actual recorded timings, not fresh isolated benchmarks. Original/online historical hardware and contention differ; SemanticOPT estimates use 3,000 continuation measurements and the continuation request telemetry. Offline training/loading excluded.
